headline: Swaraj Suiting Limited receives BSE approval for listing on Main Board following migration from NSE Emerge SME platform
sum: Swaraj Suiting Limited has received BSE approval for migration and listing of its equity shares on the Capital Market Segment (Main Board), graduating from the SME Emerge platform on NSE where it was previously listed.
implication: SME-to-mainboard migration triggers revised continuous disclosure, insider-trading and corporate-governance obligations under BSE listing rules, requiring updated investor approvals and board compliance frameworks.
detail: Swaraj Suiting Limited, previously listed on the NSE Emerge SME platform, has been approved by the BSE for listing on its Capital Market Segment Main Board. This migration represents a graduation from the SME platform to the mainboard, subjecting the company to enhanced regulatory and disclosure requirements. The approval was formally communicated to the NSE via regulatory filing on 12 August 2026. The company must now comply with BSE mainboard listing standards including higher public shareholding norms, quarterly financial reporting, and corporate governance mandates.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
framework.note: central — Mainboard listing mandates continuous disclosure, insider-trading restrictions, corporate-governance code (Reg 17–27), and related-party transaction approval.
central — Specific mainboard segment rules on shareholding patterns, board composition, audit committee formation, and quarterly compliance.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
framework.note: Governs any future capital raises post-migration; SME companies have different exemptions that cease upon mainboard listing.
Board composition, director appointment and rotation rules now apply strictly under mainboard governance regime.
Upgraded surveillance and reporting obligations for key management personnel and promoters post-migration.

framework.ref: BSE Mainboard Admission Norms (Public Shareholding: minimum 25%)
framework.note: Compliance with public float requirement; SME exemptions no longer apply.

framework.ref: SEBI Circular on SME Platform Graduation (2022 onwards)
framework.note: Procedural framework for migration and staggered compliance timelines post-listing approval.
